name: Focumon
storyline: Train creatures by completing, setting, or tracking tasks! Users choose a starter, build a "Focudex," and use Pomodoro timers (or "time stacks") to train. Focusing generates rewards (Echos/Essences) used to evolve Focumon into new forms, with over 192 creatures currently available. Users can join "focus parties," follow other trainers, and participate in shared, real-time accountability sessions
summary: Focumon is a gamified, Pokemon-inspired productivity web app designed to boost motivation for studying and work by allowing users to collect, train, and evolve over 100 pixel monsters through real-life focus sessions. It utilizes Pomodoro or flexible "Flow time" techniques, featuring multiplayer co-working, a Garden system, and integration with tools like Anki.
